correctness.rationale: The domain is 0,1,2 multiplicities; parity is of total coordinate sum and pairwise multiset intersection sum min(x_i,y_i), excluding diagonal pairs. Initial-segment embedding Φ(x) subset [n]x[2] preserves sums and pairwise min-intersections and gives F_2-orthogonal odd self-pair vectors, hence universal upper O2(n)<=2n, not n. Independent direct graph enumeration over all odd vectors (3^n-1)/2 with every increasing clique visited exactly once recomputed counts: n1 [1,1,0], n2 [1,4,2,0], n3 [1,13,30,14,0], n4 [1,40,332,744,450,72,8,0], n5 [1,121,3300,27020,73200,68874,24640,3040,0], proving exact maxima (1,2,3,6,7) with the forbidden next-size zero. The displayed 10 six-coordinate odd words have all 45 min-intersections even; disjoint-support union gives 10q+r when n=6q+r, so liminf O2(n)/n >=5/3. Independently checked enumerator and source verify.py predicate agree; finite n<=5 count is exhaustively proved, not extrapolated.
residual_risks: Exact O2(n) for n>=6 (including n=6), asymptotic optimum constant and extremal uniqueness remain unproved.
